## Problem and change

Describe the verified problem, the smallest correction and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands and actual results. Mark unavailable platform/hardware/hosted CI checks UNVERIFIED. Link new evidence; do not overwrite historical acceptance.

## Review

- [ ] Risk/resource separation, missing-data semantics and process identity preserved.
- [ ] Persistence remains observational and ML remains shadow-only.
- [ ] Focused regression included for any functional defect.
- [ ] No real secrets, state, exports, build caches or release binaries staged.
- [ ] Notices/licenses and dependency locks preserved; documentation updated.
